watches.description: Land // Sea GMT — 38mm Miyota 9075 True GMT Watch Your Time. Anywhere. The Land // Sea GMT is Seals Watch Company's dual-time tool watch, built on the same 38mm 316L stainless steel platform as the Land // Sea Classic, extended with a true traveler GMT complication and a recessed 24-hour internal chapter ring. Designed for daily wear across time zones, assembled and regulated in Sacramento, California. The Miyota 9075 movement at its core is a true traveler GMT: the local hour hand adjusts independently in one-hour increments without stopping the movement or disturbing the GMT hand. Set your home time once. Cross time zones with a single crown pull. That's it. What Is a True GMT and Why Does It Matter? GMT movements fall into two categories. A caller GMT adjusts the 24-hour hand, useful for tracking a distant time zone from one location, but cumbersome when you're actually crossing time zones. A true traveler GMT adjusts the local hour hand independently, meaning you can flip between zones without resetting minutes, seconds, or your home reference time. The Miyota 9075 is a true traveler. The Land // Sea GMT is built around this distinction. Read the full movement breakdown in our Miyota 9075 guide . Fixed Bezel. Internal 24-Hour Chapter Ring. Rather than a rotating external bezel, the Land // Sea GMT uses a fixed radially brushed bezel paired with a recessed internal 24-hour chapter ring. The bezel profile stays clean and uninterrupted. The ring, available in Burnt Sun, Olive Drab, black with summer teel or Everest Blue, provides the day/night reference from within the dial. Less external mass. More dial depth. The same time zone functionality, expressed differently. Why we chose this approach. Key Features True Traveler GMT: Miyota 9075 with independent local hour hand adjustment. Change time zones without stopping the movement. Internal 24-Hour Chapter Ring: Fixed bezel design with recessed dial ring in four colorways, Burnt Sun, Olive Drab, Everest Blue, and Summer Teal. 38mm Case: 316L stainless steel, 46mm lug-to-lug, 12.5mm thick. Wears appropriately on 6 to 8 inch wrists. Domed Sapphire Crystal: Anti-reflective coated, consistent with the Land // Sea Classic platform. 150 Meters Water Resistance: Screw-down crown, suitable for swimming and surface water use. Regulated In-House: Each movement adjusted to ±5 sec/day at time of assembly in California. Applied Indices + Super-LumiNova: Swiss lume on hands and indices for low-light legibility. 20mm Lug Width: Compatible with the full Seals strap lineup and most standard 20mm aftermarket straps. watches.description: From day one, our motto has been, “Simplistically bold for the discerning”. For us, this means to design a strong, well-built time piece of original design. watches.description: From day one, our motto has been, “Simplistically bold for the discerning”. For us, this means to design a strong, well-built time piece of original design. The design of Model A’s case stems from the utilitarian lines of the blocky tanks of the 1940’s; dramatic angular, drilled lugs on a low-slung center plate, giving way to its pronounced bezel, all consolidated into a modern 41mm size for a sweet spot of balance and presence. The case is made of 316L stainless steel, surgical grade, strong, yet malleable enough to make for an excellent casing. The crystal is of sapphire, with anti-reflective coating on the inside to reduce glare and ease visibility. Words Around the Web “Gorgeous case”, “My new favorite watch. I think we have a winner here”, “Love the look of this”, “That’s a very cool watch.
